How to use

  • Diffuse 5 drops in a morning room.
  • Blend with peppermint and rosemary for a focused desk blend.
  • Use within a year of opening and keep it cold.

Dilute before applying to skin and patch-test first. Not for internal use.

  • Pith

What's in it

Who it's for

Morning routines

Tarter and drier than orange, which makes it read as waking rather than comforting.

People who find orange too sweet

The bitter pith note stops it becoming cloying in a diffuser.

Focus and desk blends

Works well with peppermint and rosemary where orange would be too soft.

What people get wrong

Buying the large bottle for occasional use. Grapefruit is among the shortest-lived oils we sell, and a 30 ml bottle used twice a month will turn before it empties.

Forgetting that it is mildly phototoxic. Less so than bergamot, but still enough to matter on skin that is going into direct sun within half a day.

What it won't do

It fades fast. In a blend grapefruit is the first note to go, often within half an hour, which is why it is usually built over something slower.

We describe how our oils smell and how people use them. We don't make medical claims, because essential oils aren't medicine.

Questions about Pink Grapefruit

How is it different from lemon or orange?

Drier and more bitter than either, with a pithy edge. Orange is sweet, lemon is sharp and clean, grapefruit sits between them with a bitterness neither has.

Is it phototoxic?

Mildly. The limit is around 4% on skin that will see sun within twelve hours, which is far more forgiving than bergamot's 0.4%. Diffusing is unaffected.

Why does it fade so quickly?

It is a light top note made of small, volatile molecules that evaporate fast. That is also why it smells so immediate. Pair it with cedarwood or vetiver if you want it to last.

How long does it keep once opened?

About a year. Cold-pressed citrus oils oxidise faster than distilled ones, and an oxidised citrus oil is both flatter to smell and more likely to irritate skin.

What dilution should I use on skin?

Lower than most. Mildly phototoxic. Keep below 4% on skin that will see direct sun within 12 hours. For general use, dilute into a carrier oil such as jojoba and patch-test on a small area first.

Can I take it internally?

No. None of our oils are food grade and none are sold for internal use. Essential oils are extremely concentrated, and advice to add them to water or food is not advice we endorse.

How quickly will it arrive?

Orders are dispatched from Delhi within two business days and usually arrive within a further three to five, depending on where you are. Shipping is free over ₹999.
